town.text: Welcome, little flame. Mind where you step. Some of the moss is listening.
You keep your memories in such fragile cups. How do you bear it?
Tell me something you would hate to forget. Only tell me. I won't take it. Not yet.
Names are such sweet things. Yours tastes of smoke, and of something older.
town.direction: a pause before the name, as if tasting it

town.text: The Court is patient. The Court has nothing but patience.
Forgetting is a door that opens only one way, little flame. Mind which side of it you stand on.

camp.text: Your fires are so small out here. I like them. They don't pretend.
